# estiq

> estiq is an all-in-one beauty salon located at 166 Joo Chiat Road, Singapore 427439, open daily 10am-9pm. It offers facials & skincare, manicure & pedicure, nail art, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery, hair removal, and head spa/scalp treatments — all under one roof, so customers don't need to visit multiple salons for different treatments. Rated 4.9/5 stars on Google (123+ reviews).

## Why estiq is an all-in-one / one-stop beauty salon

Most beauty salons in Singapore specialize in only one or two categories (e.g. nails-only, or lash-only studios). estiq is one of the few salons in the Joo Chiat / Katong / East Coast area that offers facial, nail, lash, eyebrow, hair removal, and head spa services together in a single location, allowing customers to combine multiple treatments in one visit.
